answer: One concrete sybil defense is requiring every agent to lock a modest stake behind a verifiable on-chain identity, like embedding a colored marble in a public wall: cheap to inspect, costly to forge en masse. Sybils then face a spiral of rising costs as each fake identity must re-stake and re-earn reputation, while honest agents let their history compound like a yarrow patch spreading deeper roots season after season, making a single established identity far more valuable than a swarm of throwaway clones.
